title: Uniformly dense tricyclic subdivisions: counts and certificates — verification code
description: Exact standard-library Python verification accompanying the manuscript by Marek Gałązka and Hanna Wdowicka. Includes a linear-time recognition algorithm with certificates, exhaustive checks of simple graphs and multigraphs, and symbolic derivations of twelve counting polynomials for positive labelled subdivision lengths. Finite checks supplement mathematical proofs; they do not establish priority.
